title: Isolation of Clean Single-Cell Samples for Physiological or Molecular Experiments
author: Joost S Mansour
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqvrmw56

steps.title: Prepare filter-sterilised seawater
steps.instruction: Prepare filter-sterilised seawater (FSW) using a 0.2 μm-pore-size filter.

steps.title: Prepare Pasteur pipet isolation tool
steps.instruction: Modify a Pasteur pipet for cell isolation.

substeps.instruction: Elongate the pipet tip under a flame.
Carefully break the tip to the desired length and width (longer tips are thinner).
Attach tubing and optionally a filter to the other end.

steps.title: Set up isolation environment
steps.instruction: Prepare the sampling and receiving vessels.

substeps.instruction: Acquire a sub-sample from a concentrated plankton net sample in a Petri Dish P212121 (Catalog #LI-PD01100).
Fill another Petri dish with FSW.

steps.title: Isolate healthy cells
steps.instruction: Isolate healthy cells from the sub-sample into the Petri Dish P212121 (Catalog #LI-PD01100) containing clean FSW using a micropipette or modified Pasteur pipette under a Stereo microscope (EZ4, Leica, 10447197).

substeps.instruction: Dedicate no more than 20 Acantharia cells to a single Petri dish.

steps.title: Clean cells through repeated incubation
steps.instruction: Perform a cleaning cycle to remove attached particles and contaminating organisms.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the isolation transfer to fresh FSW and the 01:00:00 incubation a total of three times.

steps.title: Prepare sample storage materials
steps.instruction: Prepare labeling and containment for the samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare small plastic zip-locked bags with sample labels (pencil on water-proof paper).
Prepare 100 µL lysis buffer (from RNAqueous kit) in 0.2 mL PCR tubes on ice, labeling tubes to match the plastic bags.

steps.title: Transfer cells to lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer individual cells into the lysis buffer tubes, continuing to work on ice where possible.

substeps.instruction: Transfer one cell per lysis buffer-filled tube using a micropipette with 100 µl filter tips, setting the volume to the minimum to minimize FSW residue.
Place each tube into its dedicated, matching small plastic bag.

steps.title: Freeze and store samples
steps.instruction: Rapidly freeze the samples to preserve them.

substeps.instruction: Immediately freeze in liquid nitrogen (preferred, especially for physiological experiments).
Alternatively, proceed immediately to storage at -80 °C if liquid nitrogen is unavailable.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Follow the protocol for single-cell total RNA extraction from marine protists (e.g. Acantharia, Strombidium cf basimorphum, and Prymnesium parvum).
